author: Dyspa
body:
Ok, before you read this post, I'm not 100% sure if this commands can be used by staff or are installed on the server.
Now, with my previous experience as a Moderator in another server and also with what I've seen on other servers, the 2 commands named above are more useful than warn and maybe kick. 
A mute command would be very helpful if someone is spamming or swearing because with it you can make the infractor stop doing the things stated as he can't talk anymore.. Maybe 30 minute mutes so the user thinks before spamming/swearing again, this would also make the chat less messy and spammy. Now talking about the clear chat command, you can use it when there's an excessive amount of spam i
inhibe in game.
Hope this things get added in the next update.
P.S: If you add these commands and someone gets them, make sure to add an advertisement for the infractions page conserning this in each users's profile.
P.S2: You can use this for PlugDJ too.

title: [SUG] Mute - Clear Chat

replies.author: ballzi
replies.body:
Agreed. This would stop much spam and flame wars. Heres the example:

1. Random: You suck. Get better skid.
    Meowperson. Oi f***k off bish.
Leading to a flame.

2. Random: You suck get better.
    Meowperson /mute Random.
